title: orbital-cohort-throttle-with-rollback-slate
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: After several rollout incidents where a small, high-variance cohort triggered repeated rollbacks and operator churn, we need a primitive that isolates new cohorts and provides deterministic fast-rewind. This PR implements an 'Orbital Cohort Throttle' that places newly promoted cohorts into an orbit with constrained throughput using a time-windowed leaky-bucket per-cohort, and a first-class Rollback Slate artifact that snapshots routing + model-version state so operators can instant-rewind to a known-good slate. It also introduces a Shadow Fidelity Sampler that adapts how much shadow traffic is fully executed versus trimmed based on resource pressure and signal fidelity, preserving telemetry without overloading serving. Changes: controller: new OrbitalThrottleController implementing orbit windows, per-cohort leaky-bucket, slot assignment and metrics; rollback: RollbackSlate struct, manifest_hash tagging, S3 prefix uploader and TTL enforcement; sampler: ShadowFidelitySampler with dynamic policy that can toggle full-path execution, KV-cache warmups, and trace tagging; API: rollout schema additions orbit_window_ms, throttle_qps, rollback_slate_ttl_s; Console: rollout detail shows active slate, rewind action button (ACL-gated); observability: metrics and dashboards for orbit slots, rollback queues and sampler rates; docs & runbook: operational playbook covering when to trigger rewind and abort decision tree. Backwards compatibility: all rollout config fields are optional and default to legacy behavior; RollbackSlate storage reuses existing snapshot S3 bucket under a new prefix. Testing: unit tests for controller logic and slate TTL eviction, deterministic integration replay testing for cohort injection and rewind idempotency, microbenchmarks show <3% p99 overhead for ShadowFidelitySampler. Deployment plan: alpha on internal dev/staging canaries, opt-in API flag for customers, default-off on public clusters. Linked tickets: ENG-1729, ENG-1850, SUP-342. Checklist: design doc linked, unit tests, integration replay, perf benchmark, Console UI, observability hooks, docs and runbook added.
